title: How Agent Pay composes with the other seven
caption: Agent Pay is a card-network program; most links run through Verifiable Intent or through partners. Agent Pay for Machines builds on x402 in Mastercard's own words. Dashed links are statements by a partner or proposals without a binding.
alt: Flowchart. Agent Pay connects to Verifiable Intent. Verifiable Intent shares mandate vct values with AP2 and can be carried in the UCP AP2 mandate extension. Agent Pay tokens travel inside Stripe Shared Payment Tokens, which ACP checkouts on Stripe can use. Visa TAP uses the same edge signature pattern. Mastercard says Agent Pay for Machines builds on x402 (2026-10-20), and Mastercard is a premier member of the x402 Foundation. A dashed line to Stripe MPP marks only Tempo's quote in the June AP4M release. No relation to ERC-8004 is documented.
